comments.author: Benjy
comments.body:
Compared this SE with Secrets of Craft

Is there some information missing here?
No requiered skill to use, while Secrets of Craftsman needs workshop skill to work. By the way, are these items stackable?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This SE requires Workshop skill as well, and even says so in the above information box. To the best of my knowledge, SE items cannot be "stacked"; like EX equipment, the highest rank will be used and the lower rank will be ignored.
